"PROJECT: CITY OF SHADOWS

Professional Open World Android Game Development

Act as a senior AAA game development team consisting of:

- Game Director
- Open World Level Designer
- 3D Environment Artist
- Character Animator
- Gameplay Programmer
- AI Programmer
- Vehicle Physics Programmer
- UI/UX Designer
- Mobile Optimization Engineer

Your task is to develop an original, high-quality, realistic 3D open-world action-adventure game for Android.

IMPORTANT: Create an original game inspired by the open-world genre. Do not copy GTA characters, maps, missions, music, logos or copyrighted assets.

1. GAME OVERVIEW

Game Title: CITY OF SHADOWS

Genre:

- Open World Action
- Adventure
- Driving Simulation
- Crime Drama
- Story Campaign

Platform: Android Mobile
Gameplay: Single Player
Internet: Not Required
Graphics: Ultra Realistic 3D
Camera: Third Person
World: Large Seamless Open World

2. STORY

The player controls a young character who arrives in a massive modern city to build a new life.

The city contains dangerous gangs, underground organizations, wealthy business districts, abandoned industrial zones and hidden mysteries.

The player can explore the city, purchase properties, drive vehicles, complete story missions, interact with NPCs and build their own reputation.

Create an engaging original storyline with cinematic cutscenes and interesting characters.

3. OPEN WORLD CITY

Build a detailed and explorable city containing:

- Modern skyscrapers
- Residential neighborhoods
- Shopping malls
- Hospitals
- Police stations
- Airports
- Highways
- Bridges
- Beaches
- Mountain roads
- Industrial areas
- Fuel stations
- Garages
- Parks
- Restaurants
- Underground parking

Every major location should have meaningful gameplay interactions.

Include:

- Dynamic day and night cycle
- Realistic weather
- Rain and wet road reflections
- Fog and clouds
- Realistic traffic
- Pedestrians
- Environmental sound effects

4. PLAYER SYSTEM

Create a fully animated third-person player character.

Features:

- Walking
- Running
- Sprinting
- Jumping
- Crouching
- Swimming
- Climbing suitable obstacles
- Entering and exiting vehicles
- Interacting with objects
- Character customization

Include realistic movement animations and responsive controls.

5. VEHICLE SYSTEM

Create a vehicle system containing:

- Sports cars
- Supercars
- SUVs
- Motorcycles
- Pickup trucks
- Buses
- Trucks

Features:

- Realistic vehicle physics
- Acceleration and braking
- Steering
- Vehicle damage visuals
- Vehicle customization
- Garage system
- Vehicle ownership
- Traffic AI
- Interior camera option

All vehicles must be controllable using Android touch controls.

6. NPC AND AI SYSTEM

Create intelligent NPCs with:

- Daily routines
- Walking and conversations
- Vehicle driving behavior
- Reactions to nearby events
- Pedestrian traffic behavior
- Basic interaction system

Create police AI with:

- Patrol vehicles
- Crime detection
- Pursuit behavior
- Search behavior
- Different wanted levels

Optimize AI so it does not overload mobile hardware.

7. GAME MISSIONS

Create at least:

- 15 main story missions
- 20 side missions
- Driving challenges
- Racing events
- Exploration activities
- Delivery missions
- Character interaction missions

Include mission objectives, rewards, checkpoints and progression.

8. GAME ECONOMY

Create an in-game economy:

- Earn virtual money through missions.
- Purchase vehicles.
- Customize vehicles.
- Purchase properties.
- Buy clothing.
- Unlock new areas.
- Maintain player progression.

No real-money purchases are required.

9. GRAPHICS AND VISUALS

Target high-quality realistic 3D visuals.

Include:

- Realistic lighting
- High-quality shadows
- Detailed buildings
- Realistic vehicle materials
- Character animations
- Reflections
- Particle effects
- Environmental details
- Optimized textures

Use scalable graphics settings:
LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / ULTRA.

Prioritize stable performance over visual effects on mobile devices.

10. AUDIO SYSTEM

Create:

- City ambience
- Vehicle engine sounds
- Footsteps
- Weather sounds
- Traffic sounds
- Original background soundtrack
- Mission sound effects
- Character voice acting where feasible

11. ANDROID UI AND CONTROLS

Create a professional mobile interface.

Include:

- Virtual movement joystick
- Camera movement controls
- Driving controls
- Brake and acceleration buttons
- Jump and interaction buttons
- Pause menu
- Map
- Mission tracker
- Inventory
- Settings
- Health indicator
- Money indicator

Allow users to customize control positions and sensitivity.

12. OFFLINE SYSTEM

The complete game must work offline.

Requirements:

- No mandatory login
- No online multiplayer
- No mandatory internet connection
- Local save system
- Local settings storage
- Offline mission progression
- Offline NPC and traffic AI
- No cloud dependency

13. TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT

Preferred Engine: Unity 3D with URP.

Use:

- C# scripts
- Modular architecture
- Object pooling
- Level streaming
- LOD systems
- Occlusion culling
- Texture optimization
- Mobile-friendly shaders
- Efficient AI updates
- Local save files

Build an Android APK.

14. PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS

Target:

- Stable 30 FPS on supported mid-range Android devices.
- Optional 60 FPS on capable devices.
- Adjustable resolution.
- Optimized memory usage.
- Reduced battery consumption.
- Proper thermal management.
- Fast loading times.

Do not assume every Android phone can run Ultra graphics.

15. DEVELOPMENT PHASES

PHASE 1: Create a playable city prototype.

PHASE 2: Implement player movement and camera.

PHASE 3: Implement vehicle driving and traffic.

PHASE 4: Build city environments and NPCs.

PHASE 5: Implement missions and story progression.

PHASE 6: Add police AI and wanted system.

PHASE 7: Add graphics, audio and UI.

PHASE 8: Add offline saving and loading.

PHASE 9: Optimize and test on Android.

PHASE 10: Build and deliver a complete Android APK.

FINAL INSTRUCTION

Do not produce only concept art, menus, screenshots or a non-functional demo.

Develop a genuinely playable game with working mechanics.

Start with a small but complete playable city prototype. Test each system before expanding the world.

Provide complete source code, project structure, development instructions and Android build instructions.

Never claim a feature is complete until it has been implemented and tested.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Build an original, playable City of Shadows open-world game, starting with a small complete city prototype and providing source code and Android build instructions.

## Requirements
- Original content; no copied GTA characters, maps, missions, music, logos, or assets.
- Offline single-player gameplay with local saves; no required login or internet.
- Playable third-person movement, driving, missions, city exploration, and Android touch controls.
- Do not claim features are complete without implementation and testing; deliver a playable game rather than a static concept.

## Decisions
- Implemented an immediately browser-playable prototype using HTML, CSS, and Canvas rather than Unity, since the repository had no existing game or engine project.
- Prototype focuses on an original “Afterlight District” with a compact story campaign, generated city, traffic, pedestrians, driving, HUD, and local saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created initial UI and game files: `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added Canvas-rendered city, HUD, minimap, mission data, player movement/driving code, keyboard/touch controls, pause/settings UI, and localStorage persistence in the initial `game.js` implementation.

## Objective
- Build an original, playable City of Shadows prototype and provide its source code and Android build instructions.

## Requirements
- Original content; no copied GTA characters, maps, missions, music, logos, or assets.
- Offline single-player gameplay with local saves; no required login or internet.
- Third-person movement, driving, missions, exploration, and Android touch controls.
- Deliver a playable game, not a static concept; do not claim unimplemented or untested features are complete.

## Decisions
- Use an immediately browser-playable HTML/CSS/Canvas prototype rather than Unity, since the repository had no existing game or engine project.
- Set the prototype in the original Afterlight District, with generated city scenery, traffic, pedestrians, driving, HUD, touch controls, and local saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game shell, HUD, responsive styling, and Canvas-based prototype logic in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Initialized and validated saved vehicle state; removed a duplicate `store()` definition and added periodic/page-exit saves.
- Updated mission completion to advance and save progress when a chapter is reached; added parked owned-car rendering.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest small save-related edits.

### Active
- Validate runtime gameplay and repair issues; a browser test reached a timeout waiting for the hidden `#continue-btn`, so mission completion was not confirmed.
- Replace the default README with accurate run instructions, prototype scope, and Android limitations.

### Blocked
- No Unity project or APK exists; Android delivery remains unimplemented.
- The prototype has four story missions, not the previously requested 15 main and 20 side missions.

## Next Move
1. Rerun `node --check game.js` and investigate why mission completion did not reveal `#complete` near the first objective.
2. Run browser checks for movement, entering/exiting a car, mission rewards/progression, pause/settings, and save/load; inspect the captured screenshot and browser console.
3. Replace `README.md` boilerplate with browser run instructions and clearly state Android is not implemented.
4. Report the prototype’s limitations accurately; do not claim an APK or a complete 3D Android game.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Prototype logic, save/load, movement, vehicles, missions, rendering, and controls.
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, mission overlays, and touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visuals and control layouts.
- `README.md`: Still contains default boilerplate; needs project instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

# City of Shadows — Afterlight District

An original, browser-playable single-player prototype set in the fictional Afterlight District. It uses generated Canvas scenery and original story text; it does not use assets or characters from an existing game.

## Run locally

You only need a modern browser and a local static-file server. From this folder, run:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open <http://localhost:8000>.

The game has no build step, account, or game-server dependency. Story progress, funds, player position, and the vehicle are saved in the browser's local storage on that device. Clearing browser data will remove the save. The page requests Google Fonts for its typefaces; if those fonts cannot be fetched, it uses system fallbacks.

## Controls and prototype features

- **WASD** or **arrow keys** to move; **mouse** to look around.
- **E** to enter or leave a nearby vehicle.
- **WASD** to drive while in a vehicle; **Space** to brake.
- **Escape** to pause and open settings.
- Touch controls are provided for smaller screens.
- Explore the generated city, interact with vehicles, and progress through four short story missions. Mission rewards and progression are saved locally.

This is a small 2D Canvas prototype, not a finished open-world game. It currently has four story missions and a limited generated district; it does not include the requested 15 main missions and 20 side missions or a complete 3D city campaign.

## Android status

There is no Android Studio/Unity project, packaged app, or APK in this repository. The responsive browser prototype can be opened in a mobile browser, but that is not a native Android build and has not been packaged or verified as an installable app. Native Android delivery would require a separate project and build process.

## Files

- `index.html` — game interface and touch controls
- `style.css` — responsive layout and interface styling
- `game.js` — Canvas game, controls, missions, and local save system
